name: dhis2-public-portal
description: Generic static public-portal foundation for DHIS2 — Evidence + DuckDB-WASM, served from static files

scripts.build: npm run patch && npm run pages:asc && npm --prefix evidence run build
scripts.extract:anc: node scripts/dhis2-extract/index.mjs --config scripts/dhis2-extract/config/anc.yaml --out evidence/sources/anc && mkdir -p evidence/static && cp evidence/sources/anc/ou.geojson evidence/static/anc.geojson
scripts.extract:asc: node scripts/dhis2-extract/index.mjs --config scripts/dhis2-extract/config/asc.yaml --out evidence/sources/census && mkdir -p evidence/static && cp evidence/sources/census/ou.geojson evidence/static/asc.geojson
